exit_reason: the source read does not select the correct record above the declared bar and the action bars are not met

baselines.chance_note: uniform over the full candidate list, not over a held-out subset

module.name: QueryBindingCandidate
module.cache_policy: frozen parent features cached; goal query, source values, role outputs, b_goal and the internal event to z_bind path stay live and are never cached

17021.percentile: 2.5/97.5 nearest-rank on the sorted bootstrap means

17022.percentile: 2.5/97.5 nearest-rank on the sorted bootstrap means

early_kill_guard.declared_rule: if all four cells sit at or below the best constant right after the step0 read, stop instead of spending 300 steps to report the same thing
early_kill_guard.why_not_applied: step0 is the untrained reference: with freshly initialised parameters the score is uniform by construction, so this condition is always true and a stop here would measure random initialisation rather than the candidate's mechanism. SPEC 7.2 also forbids reading the dev face at intermediate points, so after a step0 stop there is no legal second read that could ever change the verdict. The rule is therefore applied at the declared endpoint (step300), where it is informative; the run stayed far inside the 1200 second allowance anyway.

limits: Synthetic composition fixture only: one reference graph (the frozen 09.8 parent) plus the declared QueryBindingCandidate, fixed 3x5 object/place template, 36-byte goals and 27-byte canonical actions. This mechanism gate is not a claim about P2 or L3, not about free-form Chinese generation, not about long-term retention, and not about the product default. Dev-facing reads happen at exactly step0 and step300; the 17022 seed is a stability re-check and is never used to pick a best candidate. Both seeds are reported separately and are never pooled into 16 independent worlds.
